hooks.name: block-destructive-aws
hooks.description: Blocks destructive AWS or recursive-delete shell commands before execution.

hooks.name: spec-task-safety-reminder
hooks.description: Adds upgrade evidence and approval requirements before every Spec task.

action.prompt: Before this task, classify it as read-only or mutating. For a mutation, require explicit current-turn user approval and state resource IDs, rollback, and cost. Do not promote without baseline and passing post-upgrade evidence. DATA01 clones are never production cutover targets.

hooks.name: validate-python-and-powershell-edits
hooks.description: Runs fast repository checks when workshop automation is saved.

hooks.name: manual-evidence-summary
hooks.description: Manual hook that reminds Kiro to summarize current evidence rather than make changes.

action.prompt: Read results/ and summarize inventory, compatibility blockers, baseline/post test differences, upgrade execution IDs, and unresolved risks. Make no AWS changes.
